decisions.reason: The burner component builds closely on the firm's established radiant-heater knowledge, so the firm can assimilate early results and improve it.
The electric infrared panel heater leverages existing heating expertise and has dedicated web presence, indicating learning and commitment.
The halogen infrared heater builds on established infrared technology and is actively presented, supporting continued absorption and improvement.
The industrial electric infrared hall heater is close to the firm's core offer and benefits from in-house R&D, making it likely to be retained.
Its hydrogen capability matches the firm's low-carbon direction and existing gas-radiant knowledge, so absorptive capacity strongly supports keeping it.
